endorsements.label: Protecting your IT infrastructure from legal attacks- Subpoenas, Warrants and Transitive Trust
endorsements.description: You think your systems and data are safe from any attack. You fear no script kiddie. You get a +5 against social engineering. Yet a single subpoena can crack your junk open wide. A search warrant might leave you with an empty server room.
